description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ContactsViewQuickcreate', which extends 'ViewQuickcreate'. The class customizes the preDisplay method to populate request variables with data from the bean, primarily for the quick create view in the Contacts module of SuiteCRM. It includes access control and licensing headers relevant to SuiteCRM and SugarCRM.

classes.name: ContactsViewQuickcreate
classes.description: A view class for the quick create interface of the Contacts module, extending the base ViewQuickcreate class and overriding the preDisplay method for custom pre-render logic.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the base preDisplay method to populate request variables with data from the bean for the quick create form, especially when using the DC menu.
